source: Hire a Children’s Book Illustrator group
author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. Prominent cover and title-page credit. Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST. Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!
